Ironically if we go by art, I actually think Ivana looks older than Tachyon except for Tachyon's F6 variant.

I admit I mostly just kinda group the heroes into three general categories:

The Team Moms and Dads: Legacy, Tachyon, AZ, Scholar, Fixer, Haka, La Comodora, 3/4 of the Sentinels

The Kids: Unity, Idealist, Young Legacy, Visionary, Muse, Harpy, possibly Anubis (I got the impression Marty was Blake's "kid sidekick", and being young would make him parallel to Thiago being Ra in Tactics), also possibly Benchmark (him dating Unity and being presented as a naive hero in general suggests he's placed as being her peer).

The Adults: Everyone else.

There's obviously age differences within these categories (Scholar and Haka are both really, really old and Fixer and La Comodora normal-person old while the others are more just closer to middle aged, Bunker is older than Wraith and I feel like Cosmic is probably older than Argent and Fanatic, etc.), but they don't seem to often materially affect how the heroes relate to each other within each category, versus differences in roles between age categories being more apparent.

We know a bit of the citizen's background from the Letter's page.

 

Spring is fully stockholmed into this whole situation. She is abused and derided by her fellow citizens, but she fully believes this is the only place for her. I imagine they've got her believing that if she ever left the citizens not only would they kill her, but with her powers she can't defend herself and the outside world will hurt and kill her because they hate people with powers.

 

I'd love for the heroes to convince her the world isn't so bad and break her conditioning, becuase I love good redemption stories. However, it's going to be rough to convince her to leave her abusers, because she fully believes they have her best interests at heart.

 

About Hammer and Anvil vs Hack and Slash, from the way Christopher and Adam talk about Hammer and Anvil there is no chance of them being uprooted from their position. Not only are they probably way more powerful, but they are signifigantly more loyal, and Dawn makes the calls. She can't trust HAck and Slash to remain loyal no matter what, but she could tell Hammer and Anvil to go on a suicide mission and they would gladly go out in a blaze of glory.

 

 

But I do like the idea of infiltrating the Citizens of the Sun, working to learn a plot or get someone out of the cult and away from Dawn. That'd be an awesome adventure. I don't think they are on Insula Primalis anymore though. Wasn't that base trashed beyond repair?

Yay a cookie! I've never got one before.

 

*sets cookie down*

 

HOLY CRAP AEON-GIRL!!!!

 

I literally squeed. It would have fit Deadline's pattern of being hated to have unleashed a new evil upon the world, but I was so hoping to see an Uub (DBZ reference, when the evil Majin Buu is destroyed he reincarnates much later as a young boy named Uub who trains under Goku)

 

And what's fascinating is that she is super malleable it sounds like. I love this, because she's the RPG character, which means that they've incorporated enough ways to be incredibly flexible that she can exist. The RPG game does have a very loose set of rules and mechanics that means anybody can try a lot of various abilities, but she sounds like she's going to push that envelope pretty far and that's some exciting news I think.

 

Plus the story that follows that, how do you react to a happy go lucky, 1 year old child who is the reincarnation of the being which tried to destroy everything and commit Omnicide? I can totally see more than one group going after her with the express purpose of killing her so that she doesn't grow up to become the threat she was before. Followed closely by those stupid and foolish enough to try and capture her and hold her against her will. And now I want art for her, sooo badly, because she could look amazing if they take some of the same crystal body structure concepts they used for Oblivaeon. Actually... that's something we've never asked. How do Oblivaeon shards interact with Oblivaeon and Aeon-Girl? They are part of them, but they can be turned against them as well. I have so many questions to ask now.

 

And the confirmation that people were likely stranded in the wrong timeline (and likely Haka is one of them from the hints Christopher and Adam dropped of someone we care about being lost in a different reality when the gates snapped shut) It's now much more likely that Luminary and a bunch of others are hanging out with the heroes.

 

All the things!

posts.cooked:
Just had a thought while posting about Nemesis Icons.

 

What if La Capitan/La Commodora are immune to time paradoxes? IF they are then what are the chances that The young La Capitan from Villains is the first version, she is taken to LA Commodora, and tasked with helping defend all of time and space during the Oblivaeon crisis. She ends up on the Nexus of the Void island, and during the course of the battles that follow she ends up a void spirit.... actually, woah, back up, reverse things.

 

I was looking at the back of their cards, because obviously young La Commodora becomes a void spirit, but what if I'm wrong about young La Commodora existing before old La Commodora?

 

The old version is seen approaching a black spot on her flip side. What is she isn't immune to paradoxes? She tries to convince her younger self to change her ways, but fails and the young La Capitan instead finds an old version of the Paradoja Magnifica and goes off to collect her crew. La Commodora wants to fight Oblivaeon, she knows the end is coming, but she is an old woman, and despite her best efforts she can't do what needs to be done.

 

So she breaks the rules. Finds that Black Spot, and uses it to reverse her aging, making her a young woman again, more capable of fighitng , but something goes wrong in the proccess. She is cursed, and goes to the Nexus to try and find an answer, or at least she goes to finish the fight before her time truly runs out.

 

 

All of this started because I wondered about the possibility of the young Commodora becoming part of Daybreak, but it seems less and less likely the more ways I slice it. And her void form looks pretty malevolent, ahe's more likely to end up as a villain again, despite what she seems to have been trying to accomplish.

I'm glad this thread got resurrected, because I was planning on making a new thread to post and discuss some of the new things we learn about the Universe.

 

Like Bunker's Riot Cannon being a finished version of the Prototype Infinity Cannon we see Expat using during the Oblivaeon Fight.

The remaining balance on AZ's suit is forgiven by the Government, freeing him from that debt

Tyler Vance was promoted to the rank of Captain before Oblivaeon, I assume he still is afterwards. Also, it seems he's coming into conflict with the military. Bunker now also has a "Deployment Satelite" for literally beaming down equipment, and magnetic atachments for suit weaponry or upgrade.

Wraith has a favorite knife, I just love that little detail

Legacy was supposedly trapped in the rubble of Freedom Tower for the entire Oblivaeon fight, never directly participating. I feel that is completely wrong though, as we've seen artwork of Paul teaming up with his daughter and father to fight Oblivaeon, so that is an odd detail.

We learn about the Void Heart, which is an interesting bit of lore

We also could see Insula Primalis as the new Nexus of the Void, which is super cool. We also learn the previous Nexus was wiped out.

We learn about the existence of GLOBAL

Miss Information has a new outfit, and a large blue eyeball following her around

Fanatic's new sword looks SICK

Akash'Flora is literally acting as a power grid for Megalopolis and allowing the existence of the Freedom Plaza

Benchmark is heading Revocorp repairs in Rook City during all of this

I also like that Unity was recruited almost specifically to help RevoCorp get past that whole "our entire existence was helping villains" stage of their lives

There are spirits in Insula Primalis, and Blade captures some of them

Blade has been mechanizing himself and his soldiers far more than he used to

 

 

In terms of Arataki/Haka... I think we are making some assumptions about how the team is thinking about this. Remember Arataki went to talk to Anthony because her closest (Current) friend in her universe was the Argent Artist. So, here is a hero, powerful in her own right, who used to lead a team very similiar to the Prime Wardens, coming to talk and maybe find some connection in this world. The heroes aren't going to push her away, especially not in the memory of Ata who was far to big hearted to do something like that.

 

And they never would insist on her changing her name either. Think about it, it'd be like telling the new guy at work that he can't go by the name Steve because your father named Steve just died. He'll probably be sorry for your loss, but your kind of being insentive and unreasonable. She is Haka, that is her name and she has earned it, there is no reason to let grief over their loss cause them to blindly hurt someone who lost far far more than they have. They lost a single friend, she lost everyone. And she's used to loss an dhas had a few months in the jungles to acclimate to the idea, but still, I can't see the team doing that to her.

posts.name: Raccoonoo
posts.cooked:
I could totally see Fanatic going "You're not the real Haka, you fiendish imposter!" because she's in a rough spot at the moment.

But yeah. Everyone else is probably okay with it.

posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
Plus Arataki's just so gosh darn adorable. She's really pretty, she gets all excited about getting to talk to her friend, she chatters on about her adventures in her universe, her picture in the last issue is all "WHOOOOO SMASHING SPIDERBOTS YAYYYYYYY".

Also a convo on Reddit reminded me to note that considering "our" Anthony's fashion sense, I can absolutely imagine the Argent Artist wearing a stereotypical beret and painter's smock, which is honestly the most adorable mental image.

Regards new revelations, I like that AZ has Intuition and Creativity as some of his qualities. Also that they make special note of him and Tachyon being best buds. And that some of Legacy's characterization has a "shaking his cane at the whippersnappers" vibe to it.

Also, some new areas of speculation:

Who do you think is on GLOBAL besides Tempest?

What do you think the bios for the new Prime Wardens will be like? Stuff like personality descriptors, principles, abilities.
